questions.q: In which year did Moldova become independent?
questions.why: It declared independence on 27 August.

questions.q: Which medieval prince is Moldova's greatest hero?
questions.why: He ruled Moldavia from 1457 to 1504.

questions.q: Who became Moldova's first woman President, in 2020?
questions.why: She was re-elected in 2024.

questions.q: Which Soviet republic was Moldova part of until 1991?
questions.why: It was created in 1940.

questions.q: Which 2009 protests are called the 'Twitter Revolution'?
questions.why: They followed disputed elections.

questions.q: Which Moldovan wine estate's wines were served at Queen Victoria's court?
questions.why: Its Negru de Purcari is famous.

questions.q: What is the capital of Moldova?
questions.why: It is famous for its parks.

questions.q: Which breakaway region on the Dniester is not under Moldova's control?
questions.why: It fought a short war in 1992.

questions.q: Which neighbour shares language and history with Moldova?
questions.why: Moldova was part of Romania from 1918 to 1940.

questions.q: Which historical region between the Prut and Dniester is today's Moldova?
questions.why: Russia annexed it in 1812.

questions.q: Which autonomous Turkic-speaking region is in southern Moldova?
questions.why: Its capital is Comrat.

questions.q: Which river forms most of Moldova's border with Romania?
questions.why: The Dniester flows to the east.

questions.q: Which landlocked country lies between Romania and Ukraine?
questions.why: It is one of Europe's smaller countries.

questions.q: What is Moldova's highest hill?
questions.why: It is only about 430 m high.

questions.q: Which poem by Alexei Mateevici is the national anthem?
questions.why: It praises the Romanian language.

questions.q: Which song by O-Zone from Moldova became a global hit in 2004?
questions.why: It is known as the 'Numa Numa' song.

questions.q: Which band from Moldova sang 'Hey Mamma' at Eurovision 2017?
questions.why: Their 'Epic Sax Guy' became a meme.

questions.q: Which folk-punk band has represented Moldova at Eurovision several times?
questions.why: They finished sixth in 2005.

questions.q: Which scholar-prince wrote 'Descriptio Moldaviae'?
questions.why: He was a member of the Berlin Academy.

questions.q: Which poet is Moldova's national poet, shared with Romania?
questions.why: He wrote 'Luceafărul'.

questions.q: In which year did Moldova become an EU candidate country?
questions.why: It applied soon after Russia invaded Ukraine.

questions.q: Which cave monastery is carved into cliffs above the Răut River?
questions.why: It is a famous archaeological complex.

questions.q: Which language is Moldova's official language?
questions.why: In 2023 the constitution named it Romanian.

questions.q: What is Moldova's currency?
questions.why: Its code is MDL.

questions.q: What is Moldova especially famous for producing?
questions.why: Wine is a large share of its exports.

questions.q: Which underground wine cellars hold a Guinness record collection?
questions.why: It has about two million bottles.

questions.q: Which cornmeal porridge is a staple?
questions.why: It is served with cheese and sour cream.

questions.q: Which spring custom involves giving red-and-white threads?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's list.

questions.q: Which underground wine city has streets named after grapes?
questions.why: Its tunnels run for about 120 km.

questions.q: Which pies filled with cheese or cabbage are a Moldovan snack?
questions.why: They are often fried or baked.
